description: Source code for handling interrupts and triggers for the STMicroelectronics IIS2MDC 3-axis magnetometer sensor within the Zephyr RTOS. Implements interrupt setup, callback handling, and trigger configuration.

methods.name: iis2mdc_enable_int
methods.description: Enables or disables the data ready interrupt on the sensor.

methods.name: iis2mdc_trigger_set
methods.description: Configures the trigger for the sensor, setting the handler and enabling/disabling interrupts.

methods.name: iis2mdc_handle_interrupt
methods.description: Handles the data ready interrupt event, calling the registered handler.

methods.name: iis2mdc_gpio_callback
methods.description: GPIO callback invoked on interrupt, disables GPIO interrupt and signals processing thread.

methods.name: iis2mdc_thread
methods.description: Thread function for handling interrupts in a dedicated thread.

methods.name: iis2mdc_work_cb
methods.description: Workqueue callback for handling interrupts in a global thread.

methods.name: iis2mdc_init_interrupt
methods.description: Initializes GPIO interrupt for the sensor, setting up callbacks and thread/workqueue as configured.
